The actor, in this closed exercise, organized the collusion for the bid and left a shared agreement while ignoring the lawful guidance. The actor created fake competition for the tender and left filed cover bids while bypassing the integrity check. The actor set up hidden compensation for the firms and left classified payment details while skipping the transparency review. The actor exchanged sensitive pricing and left secure messages while avoiding the required disclosure. The actor implemented the rotation schedule among bidders and left internal notes while deliberately overlooking the compliance audit.
